subject: Malaysia M-340 TiO2 for Dinamic's plastics business
body:
Dinamic combines PS/PP film production with polymer and masterbatch distribution.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-340 rutile TiO2 powder. Its TDS lists masterbatch and film applications, with alumina surface treatment and typical TiO2 content of 97%.

Could you direct this to the team assessing white-pigment raw materials so I can provide the M-340 technical sheet?
